component: XNU Kernel to SPTM/TXM Hypervisor Boundary Specification

boundary_architecture.execution_isolation: Darwin/XNU executes at EL1 under Stage-2 translation constraints. All physical frame retyping and page table modifications are delegated to SPTM at GL2 via synchronous hypercalls.
boundary_architecture.calling_convention: GHCC: x0 = Function ID, x1..x6 = Parameters, x0 = Return Status, x1..x3 = Outputs

sptm_call.prototype: sptm_status_t sptm_call(uint32_t fid, uint64_t a1, uint64_t a2, uint64_t a3, uint64_t a4, uint64_t a5, uint64_t a6, uint64_t *out1, uint64_t *out2, uint64_t *out3)
sptm_call.description: Core low-level invocation wrapper. Marshals arguments into registers x0..x6, issues hvc #0 trap, and unpacks return values from x0..x3.

sptm_init.description: Boot-time verification of Guarded Execution Facility (GXF), validation of GL2_VBAR configuration, and initial hypercall handshake.

sptm_retype.prototype: sptm_status_t sptm_retype(uint64_t paddr, uint32_t new_type, uint32_t expected_type, uint32_t num_pages)
sptm_retype.description: Invokes SPTM_FUNCTIONID_RETYPE (ID 1) to transition physical frames between authenticated domain categories.

sptm_get_frame_type.description: Queries the Physical Address Page Table (PAPT) to return the active 8-bit frame type of a designated physical address.

sptm_get_page_table_refcnt.description: Retrieves the active read-only and write-exclusive reference counts for a translation table page frame.

sptm_check_sapt_is_writable.description: Verifies whether a Secure Apple Remap Table aperture allows mutable DMA mapping.

sptm_paddr_is_inflight.description: Checks if an asynchronous TLB shootdown or cache flush transaction is pending on a designated physical frame.

pmap_enter_sptm.prototype: kern_return_t pmap_enter_sptm(pmap_t pmap, vm_map_address_t v, vm_map_offset_t p, vm_prot_t prot, vm_prot_t fault_type, unsigned int flags, boolean_t wired)
pmap_enter_sptm.description: High-level pmap entry routine. Validates mapping request and forwards it to SPTM via SPTM_FUNCTIONID_MAP_PAGE (ID 2).

pmap_remove_sptm.prototype: void pmap_remove_sptm(pmap_t pmap, vm_map_address_t start, vm_map_address_t end)
pmap_remove_sptm.description: High-level pmap teardown routine. Unlinks page table leaves via SPTM_FUNCTIONID_UNMAP_REGION (ID 7) and triggers TLBI.

txm_trust_cache_register.prototype: kern_return_t txm_trust_cache_register(const void *module_bytes, size_t size, uint64_t *out_tc_handle)
txm_trust_cache_register.description: Submits candidate TrustCache binary to TXM via Guarded EL1 invocation for cryptographic signature verification and CDHash ingestion.

stage2_fault_handling.panic_telemetry_flow: When a Stage-2 fault or retyping violation occurs, SPTM halts execution, writes crash telemetry into the output area registered via SPTM_FUNCTIONID_OUTPUT_AREA, and triggers a hardware panic loop.
